name: Natal Explorers
source: Follow Rafa and Duda in Natal Explorers: an exciting journey through the city of Natal, in which you will learn historical, scientific and cultural curiosities in the capital of Rio Grande do Norte!
translation: 跟随拉法与杜达，在《纳塔尔探索者》中展开一段穿越纳塔尔市的精彩旅程，了解北里奥格兰德州首府的历史、科学与文化趣闻！
